title: Website Opportunities template pins are read on the server: a demo build naming only its CMS takes the /ops/wo pin of that CMS (Tracy Base by default), a pin no longer offered falls back to the restaurant fit or is refused under the strict policy, a requested template of another CMS is refused 400, the /ops/wo Default CMS is what Settings offers accounts with none, and GET /api/ops/wo says whether each pin is offered; a build the host could not finish reads failed with the host's reason and builds again in place through its failed demo action, the same CMS and template on a live demo is refused 409 BUILD_EXISTS before any charge, a brief run lost on restart settles at start; QA rediscovers nav, footer and sitemap every round, skips drafts, and flags empty picture frames, hidden placed pictures and quoted Google reviews, which are neither site content nor facts
steps: S1: POST /api/website-opportunities/:id/demo/build naming only the CMS (joomla) while Design inspiration offers tracy-base/j6, with nothing saved on /ops/wo, then with joomla pinned to tracy-business/j6.
S2: the same press while the pin is not offered, under the default policy and under strict.
S3: the same press naming {quickstart: 'tracy-base/wp7', design: 'tracy'} for a Joomla account, and a template no card offers.
S4: /ops/wo Default CMS is wordpress and the account has chosen no CMS: read Settings, then build on wordpress and on emdash.
S5: GET /api/ops/wo with tracy-base/j6 unpublished from the shelf, tracy-base/wp7 shown and no EmDash release.
S6: PUT /api/ops/wo/settings with tag pins and templatePinPolicy strict, then with a slug, a three-part tag, an unknown CMS, or the old policy refuse.

S7: GET /api/website-opportunities/revisions/:revId of a revision of 'Pho Ba', then again with a site labelled pho-ba on the deployment; POST …/revisions/:revId/build with no label, with a blank one, with 'my-pho' and with 'Bad name!'; POST …/:id/demo/build with label 42; a refused auto-named build that the demo worker retries after somebody took its name.

S8: a build whose site job the host reports failed, retried through its failed demo action (retryOf); the same CMS and template pressed under a new requestId while the first demo is live, then another template, then the same choice once the first demo failed; a build stuck in requesting past 10 minutes; a brief run whose process died before the web restarted.

S9: a QA round on a site whose nav changed after the repair, with a drafted page redirecting home, a footer-only and a sitemap-only page, an empty gallery frame, a placed picture inside a closed <details>, and a paragraph copying eight words of a Google review; a brief whose stored markdown still carries reviews is handed off. A Joomla build whose plan keeps /menu/simple-menu while home's nav shows only the alias /index.php/menu; a plan page that 404s; a build marked deleted on a revision.
expect: S1: 202; the demo action's choice is template {quickstart: 'tracy-base/j6', design: 'tracy', version: '1.4.0', reason: 'pinned'}; then tracy-business/j6 with reason pinned.

S2: default: the choice is ja-restaurant with reason 'pin-missing:tracy-base/j6;restaurant-match'; strict: 409 TEMPLATE_PIN_UNAVAILABLE {pin: 'tracy-base/j6', cms: 'joomla'} and no wo_demo_action row (nothing charged).
S3: 400 INVALID_TEMPLATE both times and no wo_demo_action row; a template offered for Joomla is reason requested.
S4: GET settings says wordpress; a wordpress build takes tracy-base/wp7; an emdash build reads cms emdash, cmsSource account, template tracy-base/emdash-0.x.
S5: templateStatuses joomla found true offered false, wordpress found true offered true, emdash found false offered false.
S6: 200 with the pins saved (an empty pin reads as the default) and the policy strict; 400 INVALID_PINNED_TEMPLATE or INVALID_TEMPLATE_PIN_POLICY for each junk value.

S7: suggestedLabel pho-ba, then pho-ba-2; the build without a label (or blank) asks the create door for pho-ba-2 and answers build.label pho-ba-2; my-pho is sent as typed; Bad name! is refused INVALID_LABEL on the build and 42 answers 400 INVALID_LABEL at the demo door; the worker's retry asks the create door again for the same build with the name it chose first. siteLabelFor("Nhan's Kitchen", {cms: 'joomla', suffix: 'base'}) is nhans-kitchen-j-base.

S8: GET build reads failed with receipt.failure {code: PROVISION_FAILED, reason}; the retry through the failed action asks the create door again with the same buildId and name and reads done; the same choice again answers 409 BUILD_EXISTS with the live build, no second demo action and no second site; another template builds a second demo of the same brief; once the first demo failed the same choice builds again; the stuck one reads failed REQUEST_LOST; the dead run settles within the first tick with timings.lost LOST_ON_RESTART instead of after 4 minutes.

S9: round 2 reads the new nav; the drafted page is visited, not judged twice as home; footer and sitemap pages are judged; no-empty-picture-slots, placed-pictures-visible and no-google-review-quoted fail with page and selector; the hand-off prompt carries no Google review text; a plan row without a path is listed under unmatched, never a PAGE_PLAN_MISSING. The plan's kept pages are read (Joomla at /index.php/<route>) and judged — template prices on Simple Menu are flagged by facts-from-brief as sample content; a plan page that 404s is visited from plan, not judged, and reads PAGE_PLAN_MISSING; a deleted build does not answer BUILD_EXISTS.

evidence: Stand wo2 runs 1–3 (Tracy Base × wp7/j6/emdash, Opal Moon Bistro, 19/10/2026 09:29–10:42Z): tasks/evidence-wo-per-template/README.md, wordpress-base.md (L1–L5), joomla-base.md (J1–J5), emdash-base.md (E1–E4)
fence: chooseTemplate takes the CMS pin and its policy and answers {refusal} for a requested card not offered on that CMS or a pin not offered under strict; createRevision rolls back on a refusal and resolves the CMS through resolveRevisionCms (account, else /ops/wo defaultCms); normalizeWoOpsSettings reads a non-tag pin as the default and refuse as strict; parseWoOpsSettingsInput refuses non-tag pins and unknown policies; readWoTemplateStatuses reports offered from templateCards(readReleases); startBuild asks for the body label, else the row's earlier label, else suggestedLabel (siteLabelFor + nextSiteLabel over site, directory_site, label_registry and site_name), and stores it on wo_build.label

tests: pins: a build naming only its CMS takes the CMS pin saved on /ops/wo
pins: an operator pin on /ops/wo wins over the default pin
pins: a pin no longer offered falls back to the restaurant fit and says why
pins: a pin no longer offered under the strict policy is refused 409 before any work or charge
pins: a requested template of another CMS, or not offered, is refused 400
pins: the /ops/wo Default CMS is what Settings offers an account with none; each CMS builds on its pin
GET /api/ops/wo says per CMS pin whether Design inspiration still offers it
settings pins: a release tag and the strict policy are saved; a junk tag or policy is refused 400
settings pins: the new defaults are Tracy Base; slugs and policies saved before #1436 read as today
build: no label → the server names the site after the place, and a taken name gets -2
build: a label sent is kept, a retry without one keeps the first choice, a bad one is refused
siteLabelFor turns a place name into a site label: no accents, lower case, single hyphens
siteLabelFor adds the CMS short name and a suffix when asked
siteLabelFor keeps room for "-NN": the name part stops at 55, the whole label below 63
nextSiteLabel answers the base when free, else the first free -2, -3…
pagePlanMissing: a page the build kept that the site does not reach fails PAGE_PLAN_MISSING; soft shapes; none without a plan
briefOf: Google reviews are not facts — their words never reach the judge, the rest of the brief does
a process that starts settles at once the open rows a dead process left
runDemoQa: discovery is nav, then footer and sitemap; a page that lands on home or a footer/sitemap 404 is visited, not judged
runDemoQa: a nav link that lands on home (a drafted page) is not judged as a second home
no-empty-picture-slots: a picture frame that shows no picture fails, with its page and selector
placed-pictures-visible: a picture Tracy placed that no page shows (hidden block, closed details) fails; one shown anywhere, on a phone or in a carousel does not
no-google-review-quoted: eight words in a row from a Google review fail (case, spacing and punctuation aside); seven do not
build: a provision the host failed reads failed with the host reason, and the same requestId builds it again
build: one live demo per (brief, choice) — the same CMS and template again is refused BUILD_EXISTS before any charge
build: only requesting, provisioning and done are live — a build in any other state (deleted) does not block a rebuild
runDemoQa: the pages a build kept are read beside what nav finds — on Joomla under /index.php; one that 404s is visited, not judged
demoQaBody: the plan widens the page cap past the nav cap, up to a ceiling
a build with a page plan: the host is asked to read every kept page with a path, beside what nav finds
